title: team_registry
description: Organisation-level mapping between team names across PRD, RFC, code repo, and dashboard. Maintained once; read by sdet-plan-generator and automation-plan-generator. Prevents name drift from causing wrong module paths or regression mismatches.

canonical_id.description: Stable lowercase slug used in sdet_plan.json and automation_plan.json. Never changes even if team renames.

display_name.description: Human-readable name shown in qa_analysis.md and reports.

aliases.description: All known name variants per system. Matching is case-insensitive and strips hyphens/spaces.

prd.description: Values seen in prd_context.team[], prd_context.involved_teams[].team, prd_context.pdg[]

pdg.description: Values seen in BrowserStack project names and dashboard PDG labels

module.description: Exact module directory name in the test code repo. Used by automation-plan-generator for package path construction.

package_prefix.description: Root Java package for this team's test classes, e.g. com.gojek.transport.test

regression_id_prefix.description: Prefix used to filter regression_context.json entries for this team, e.g. TRANSPORT- or PAY-

browserstack_project.description: Exact BrowserStack project name. Written into team_ownership[].browserstack_project in rfc_context and used for CSV routing.

pods.description: Informational only — POD names within this module as they appear in GitLab CI yml files. Not used for alias matching; useful for understanding which sub-team owns a given feature area.
